<translate>
<!--T:2-->
The '''Frieza Saga''' is the third saga of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]]. It opens once you complete every quest of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] and takes place on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]: Frieza's army, the Ginyu Force and Frieza's four forms in the Ajissa Plains, with stops at the Namekian Ruins, the Grand Elder's House and Frieza's Ship, a spar with Nail and [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]]'s summoning, then the escape back to Earth.
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:3-->
Completing every quest of the Frieza Saga opens the [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:5-->

</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:93-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:94-->
* Zarbon and Frieza's second form transform mid-fight, switching to their next form with new stats.
* Quest 22, ''Summon Porunga'', needs the seven Namek Dragon Balls. Find them with the Namek [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragon Radar|Dragon Radar]]; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Porunga|Porunga]] for summoning and his wishes.
* Several Movies Saga quests (Cooler's Armored Squadron, Cooler and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]]) open after quests 5, 14, 15 and 16 of this saga.
</translate>
